faq.q: Can I change the countdown timer in my sale video?
faq.a: Yes. Set the timer’s size, color, and position to fit your sale ad. Check the end date before posting.

faq.q: Can I keep the same scene and only swap the next offer?
faq.a: Yes. Change the offer, message, or end date while keeping the product scene. You can refresh a sale ad in minutes.

faq.q: Can I run the download as a paid sale ad?
faq.a: Yes. Download the watermark-free sale video for paid ads. Check the offer and the platform’s rules first.

faq.q: Can I add the clip I already filmed?
faq.a: Yes. Add your own product clips or photos to the sale video. Mix them with new scenes without arranging another shoot.

faq.q: Can I make sale videos for many products in one sitting?
faq.a: Yes. Make a separate sale video from each product link. Review every product and offer before you publish.

faq.q: How many credits does a sale video use?
faq.a: A 6-second video uses 24 credits; 10, 15, and 30 seconds use 40, 60, and 120. A sale photo uses 24 credits.

faq.q: Can one AI avatar present the product through the sale?
faq.a: Yes. Choose an AI actor to present your sale product. You can make a new promotion without hiring a presenter or filming.

faq.q: Can I make sale videos from product links using an API?
faq.a: Yes. Send product links through the API to make sale ads for many items. It saves time when you have a large catalog.

faq.q: Can I show the earlier price beside the sale price in the ad?
faq.a: Only if you really charged that earlier price. Check the rules where you sell before an old price sits next to the new one.
